versions.subject: New Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/Create '
        - '}"' # Ending of the name to avoid possible FP in the rest of the commandline
selection_tn:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Can start with single or double quote
        - '/TN "{'
        - "/TN '{"
condition: all of selection_*

versions.subject: Update proc_creation_win_susp_guid_task_name.yml
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: '/Create '
selection_tn:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Can start with single or double quote
        - '/TN "{'
        - "/TN '{"
        - "/TN {"
selection_end:
    CommandLine|contains:
        # Ending of the name to avoid possible FP in the rest of the commandline
        - '}"'
        - "}'"
        - '} '
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="*/Create *" CommandLine IN ("*/TN \"{*", "*/TN '{*", "*/TN {*") CommandLine IN ("*}\"*", "*}'*", "*} *")
